passages.text:
Cellmate (speaking slowly, making sure DC can read his lips, and handing him his notebook and pen) - First time in?

[DC nods and writes in the notebook. He then shows it to Cellmate.]

[[Yes. I’m DC. Deaf. You…?]]
passages.name: Untitled passage

passages.text:
Cellmate (reading) 
[[Chico. You need to pay attention here. People watch each other. If you look weak or lost, it can be a problem.]]

links.name: Chico. You need to pay attention here. People watch each other. If you look weak or lost, it can be a problem.

passages.name: Yes. I’m DC. Deaf. You…?

passages.text:
[DC writes again, a bit tense.]

[[Should I talk to anyone?]]
passages.name: Chico. You need to pay attention here. People watch each other. If you look weak or lost, it can be a problem.

passages.text:
Chico (speaking, pointing to the notebook and then to himself) 

[[Not at first. Stay apart until you see who you can trust. I’ll keep an eye out, but you have to handle things yourself too. That’s how people respect you.]]

passages.name: Should I talk to anyone?

passages.text:
[DC writes again.]

[[How do I know who to trust?]]

links.name: How do I know who to trust?
links.link: How do I know who to trust?

passages.name: Not at first. Stay apart until you see who you can trust. I’ll keep an eye out, but you have to handle things yourself too. That’s how people respect you.

passages.text:
Chico (speaking, even tone):
[[You watch. Pay attention to how people act, not what they say. Respect isn’t given.]]

links.name: You watch. Pay attention to how people act, not what they say. Respect isn’t given.

passages.name: How do I know who to trust?

passages.text: [DC signs "thank you." Chico just nods. Chico quietly shreds the page DC wrote on and tosses the pieces into the trash.]
passages.name: You watch. Pay attention to how people act, not what they say. Respect isn’t given.
